skill.name: bankbridge
skill.description: Answer financial questions using read-only data from connected US banks, credit cards, and brokerages through the BankBridge MCP server.
skill.summary: Review balances, spending, recurring charges, cash flow, and investments with BankBridge account data.
skill.author: bankbridge-money

security_audit.summary: All 19 static findings are false positives: Markdown backticks, documented service URLs, and financial query examples do not demonstrate shell execution or system reconnaissance. The remote service handles sensitive financial data, but its implementation and read-only enforcement were not available for verification.

content.value_statement: Financial questions become harder when balances and transactions are spread across several accounts. BankBridge guides your assistant through read-only account queries and consistent spending analysis.
actual_capabilities: Routes balance, account, and credit utilization questions to account tools.
Retrieves spending summaries grouped by category, merchant, month, or week.
Finds recurring charges and checks merchant history before identifying possible duplicates.
Compares monthly income and spending through cash flow queries.
Retrieves holdings and investment transactions for portfolio and dividend questions.
Lists and searches transactions with filters and pagination while excluding internal transfers from spending totals.
limitations: Requires an authenticated BankBridge MCP connection and connected US financial accounts.
Cannot move money, pay bills, or place trades.
Results depend on bank responses; connection warnings can mean totals exclude some accounts.
The skill states pricing of $5 monthly or $50 annually per connected bank; confirm current pricing before subscribing.

use_cases.title: Review Household Spending
use_cases.description: Compare spending categories across months and avoid counting credit card payments or transfers between your accounts twice.

use_cases.title: Investigate Recurring Charges
use_cases.description: Review subscriptions and merchant history to identify unfamiliar charges or possible duplicates.

use_cases.title: Review Investment Income
use_cases.description: Inspect brokerage holdings and investment transactions to summarize dividends and portfolio activity.

prompt_templates.title: Check Account Balances
prompt_templates.prompt: Show my connected accounts and current balances. Report any connection warnings.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Spending
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare my grocery spending for the last two complete months. Exclude credit card payments and transfers between my accounts.

prompt_templates.title: Review Subscriptions
prompt_templates.prompt: List my recurring charges and investigate possible duplicates using merchant history. Explain uncertain matches without assuming fraud.

prompt_templates.title: Assess Cash Flow
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare income and spending for the last three complete months. Calculate averages, flag seasonal categories, and report missing accounts or connection warnings.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: combine monthly queries with coverage checks.

output_examples.input: Illustrative request: Compare grocery spending for two months.
output: Illustrative result: Grocery spending was $420 in September and $390 in August.
Credit card payments and transfers between your accounts were excluded.

output_examples.input: Illustrative request: Show my recurring charges.
output: Illustrative result: Three monthly charges total $48: video streaming $18, music $12, and a gym membership $18.
Two merchant spellings refer to the same video service, so they are not automatically duplicates.
One bank needs reconnection; these totals cover only responding accounts.

best_practices: Refresh the account list at the start of each session and report connection warnings.
Use at least three months for averages and exclude credit card payments and transfers between your accounts from spending.
Keep financial data in the conversation unless the user explicitly requests sharing with another tool or service.
anti_patterns: Do not request transfers, bill payments, or trades through this read-only service.
Do not label charges as duplicates before checking merchant history and descriptor variations.
Do not project annual spending from one month or present partial bank coverage as complete.

faq.question: Can BankBridge move money or trade investments?
faq.answer: No. The skill describes read-only access and explicitly excludes transfers, bill payments, and trades.

faq.question: What must I connect before using it?
faq.answer: Authenticate the BankBridge MCP connection and link your supported US bank, credit card, or brokerage accounts.

faq.question: Does the service require payment?
faq.answer: The skill lists $5 monthly or $50 annually per connected bank. Confirm current pricing during setup.

faq.question: How does it avoid counting spending twice?
faq.answer: It excludes credit card payments from checking and transfers between your accounts. Transfers to other people can still count as spending.

faq.question: What happens when a bank does not respond?
faq.answer: The assistant should show connection warnings and explain that totals include only responding banks.

faq.question: Does this audit verify the remote service?
faq.answer: No. This review covers the skill instructions, not the remote server implementation or its enforcement of read-only access.
